audit_methodology: Analyzed cross-layer-map.json, ENGINE_TO_CAPABILITY mapping, verification graph, and planner dependency chains to identify actual verified dependencies between engines

shared_infrastructure: core_domain_money - shared domain models for monetary values (used by credit_card_engine, account_engine, loan_engine, balance_engine, cashflow_engine)
common_calculations - shared financial calculation utilities (used by multiple engines)
financial_events - event sourcing infrastructure (used by reconciliation_engine, transaction_intelligence, financial_intelligence)
shared_contracts: Capability interfaces defined in cross-layer-map.json capabilities section
DTO models in backend/src/models/ (shared across engines)
Router/service contracts in backend/src/routers/ and backend/src/services/
no_verified_dependency: behaviour_engine - analytics-only, no direct financial mutations
recommendation_engine - reads-only, no financial state changes

impact_resolution_precision.precision_level: CAPABILITY_LEVEL - changes to an engine invalidate only that engine's capability evidence
impact_resolution_precision.limitation: Shared infrastructure (core_domain_money, common_calculations, financial_events) changes do NOT automatically invalidate dependent engine evidence unless explicitly modeled
impact_resolution_precision.risk: Changes to shared infrastructure may silently bypass invalidation for dependent engines

strengthening_proposal_safety_analysis.step_1_affected_capabilities: Planner determines affected capabilities from changed files via ENGINE_TO_CAPABILITY
strengthening_proposal_safety_analysis.step_2_affected_components: Direct mapping from capability to engine component
strengthening_proposal_safety_analysis.step_3_dependent_invariants: NOT CURRENTLY AUTOMATED - requires manual identification of shared domain invariants
strengthening_proposal_safety_analysis.step_4_targeted_revalidation_safety: Only the explicitly affected component is revalidated; shared infrastructure dependencies are not automatically included
strengthening_proposal_safety_analysis.step_5_escalation: Only when evidence requires broader verification (not automated)
